text: Yes. Like I said, I need this fixed today. Can you also help me exchange the Makeup Kit in order #W5056519? It's the light skin tone, professional size, Brand B kit. I want to exchange it for the dark skin tone, Brand A kit.
zh: 是的。就像我说的，我今天需要解决这个问题。您能帮我更换订单 #W5056519 中的 Makeup Kit 吗？它是浅肤色，专业尺寸，Brand B 套装。我想把它换成深肤色，Brand A 套装。
